common.title: Labour Displacement Wave
common.line: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Cable repair failure
notable.line: Neutral repair consortium fails to restore Atlantic cables after further wartime interference and insurance withdrawal, leaving EU clinics and compute queues on prolonged rationing.

notable.title: Neutral site strike
notable.line: US or Chinese strike debris or targeting error directly damages EU cable landing or fab-adjacent site, forcing Brussels to invoke protection of non-belligerent infrastructure.

notable.title: Therapy tourism blackmarket
notable.line: Municipal clinics in Lyon, Krakow and Porto begin openly rationing tailored immune therapies by residency, triggering cross-border patient travel and a black market in treatment slots that DG SANTE cannot police.
